title: Luxury Homes Under $1.5M in the Austin Metro
excerpt: Not every luxury buyer is shopping the $3M+ tier.
body:
People searching Austin-area real estate for “luxury homes Austin under 1.5 million”, “upscale houses for sale Austin TX”, and “Westlake homes under 1.5M” want a local, practical answer.

Not every luxury buyer is shopping the $3M+ tier.

A significant segment targets the $900k–$1.5M band for updated finishes, larger lots, or desirable school zones without ultra-premium pricing.

In 2026 this range still delivers solid inventory in parts of Northwest Hills, Steiner Ranch, Circle C, and select pockets of Cedar Park and Leander, though core Westlake and Tarrytown often push higher.

What these buyers filter for: recent renovations, outdoor living spaces, three-car garages, and low-maintenance yards.

Days-on-market data shows well-presented homes in this band still move when priced to recent closed sales rather than peak-era aspirations.

Tip for buyers: Watch for price reductions on homes that have sat 45+ days. For sellers in this range, professional photography and accurate pricing relative to the last 60–90 days of comps matter more than ever.
